title: Add buyer order reference to ZUGFeRD export
summary: ZUGFeRD export now includes the buyer order reference as BuyerOrderReferencedDocument to associate invoices with customer purchase orders, matching other German e-document formats.
key_points: External document number is now exported as BuyerOrderReferencedDocument/IssuerAssignedID
Change applies to ZUGFeRD sales invoices and credit memos
Aligns ZUGFeRD export with other German e-document format implementations
Regression test added for posted sales invoice export
